df40_eval_subset.caveat: Guard-waived: one unlabelled compression level, one unknown generator. Not a leave-one-generator-out result. SHORTCUT, measured 2026-09-23: Lab colour means alone separate this corpus's real and fake halves at AUC 0.843 on a val-fit/test-report split. Its halves come from different upstream sources, so any in-distribution number here measures source identification at least as much as forensics. EFFECTIVE SAMPLE SIZE, measured 2026-09-23: the 1601 fakes fall into 45 filename families, the largest holding 999 of them (62%), for a Kish effective n of 2.4. Intervals over this corpus are resampled over families (corpora.df40.source_group), not rows; every interval reported before this date was roughly 26x too narrow on the fake side. Matching native resolution and container format does not remove the colour shortcut: it raises separation from 0.800 to 0.904. PERMUTATION NULL, measured 2026-09-23: fitting a model on SHUFFLED training labels and reporting it here yields 0.229-0.780 across four training pairs, so a model that learnt NOTHING lands as far from chance as any this project has fitted. Every AUC recorded against this corpus, this card's included, is inside that null; the 0.316 reported on 2026-09-23 as a resolved negative result is retracted (p=0.33). RULING: this corpus can neither support NOR refute a detector. A bootstrap interval here is not evidence without a permutation null beside it (bench.metrics.permutation_null). IDENTITY, measured 2026-09-23 with dfd.embed (SFace): the 125 declared subjects hold 419 of 7,750 subject pairs at cosine >= 0.363 (5.41%, max 0.9908) against a 0.21% unrelated-face rate -- 26x the null. subject_id here is a filename family, not an identity, so ANY split partitioned on it leaks. That is a third independent reason this corpus cannot measure a detector, alongside the colour shortcut and the permutation null.
df40_eval_subset.source: DF40 test split, ungated repackaging; see assets/manifest.yaml

blend_seam.note: INVERTED as a point estimate, but the honest 95% CI is 0.230-0.670 and contains 0.500: this corpus cannot establish 'inverted rather than weak' (see corpus.caveat). It ranks real frames as more fake than fakes. Refitting on the eval corpus's own reals gives 0.344, so it is not domain shift. Slot A finds composite boundaries; three quarters of DF40 has none. Refitting the SAME features on DF40 val reaches 0.800 on DF40 test, so the features are not blind — the self-blend training target was wrong. That number is in-distribution and mostly the colour shortcut above; it cannot pass this gate, by design. RETRACTED FRAMING, 2026-09-23: not merely 'cannot establish inverted rather than weak' — cannot establish anything. 0.289 is inside this corpus's permutation null (see corpus.caveat), as is every other number measured on it.

gend_clip.note:
BELOW THE FLOOR, AND NOT INSIDE ITS NULL. Two measurements, both under 0.75, so slot D does not open the gate; which of them is quoted does not change that.

HEADLINE (the `auc` above), controlled in-domain, 2026-11-11: session AUC 0.663 over 125 sessions (58 genuine / 67 swapped, 509 frames) of vkyc_capture_corpus, genuine half re-encoded at quality 95 — the one quality reproducing the swapped half's luma table exactly, so one JPEG header byte can no longer label 99.2% of the corpus. TPR@0%FPR is 0.015, which is the number a reviewer would actually feel. Frames are not independent: Kish ESS is 106.9 over 509 frames, so sessions are the unit. The interval above is a percentile bootstrap resampling SESSIONS, not frames (n=1000, bench/gend_vcip.json). READ ITS UPPER END: 0.763 sits above the 0.75 floor, so 125 sessions cannot resolve 0.663 from the floor in either direction — this corpus can no more exclude a slot D that clears the floor than establish one. The gate reads the point estimate, deliberately: an interval straddling the floor is a reason to measure more, not a licence to quote whichever end suits. The lower end excludes 0.5, but a bootstrap interval is not a permutation test and none was run on this corpus; the evidence that slot D reads something is the leave-one-generator-out result below, which does sit outside its own null.

THIS NUMBER IS THE FROZEN PAIR'S. A deployment with Phase 2's LayerNorm-tuned pair installed scores with that instead (dfd.detectors.registry.slot_d_pair), and its capture-corpus session AUC is 0.7594, CI 0.672-0.839. It is not this card's `auc` because the paired gain over frozen is -0.007 to +0.199 and so is not established (bench/phase2_verdict.json, question 5). Quoting 0.7594 here would open the gate on a difference this corpus did not resolve.

THE ENCODER SHORTCUT IS NOT WHAT THIS DETECTOR READS: uncontrolled session AUC is 0.664 against the controlled 0.663. Removing the shortcut moves slot D by 0.001. That is the opposite of slot C's behaviour on the same corpus and is the main thing this evaluation established.

LEAVE-ONE-GENERATOR-OUT, 2026-11-10 (bench/gend_report.json): worst fold is `sbi` at 0.738, 95% CI 0.726-0.751, n=2,988. It sits OUTSIDE the permutation null 0.449-0.561 (48 shuffles, p = 0.020), so there is signal here and this is not a number inside its own null. It is still 0.012 under the floor. Kish ESS 996.4 by group; 4.47 on the fake side, so fake-side intervals are resampled over families.

DISTRUST THE BEST FOLDS. The four compositing folds read 0.984-0.999 and must not be quoted as slot D's performance: they are classical warp/mask/blend composites generated in this repo, and a detector that beats a hard-blended boundary has not been shown to beat FSGAN, InSwapper or any diffusion pipeline. `sbi` is the worst fold precisely because self-blends are the only fold without a visible composite seam, which is why it is the one reported.

SHORTCUT CONTROLS. Colour: a logistic model on Lab colour means alone, fitted and scored IN SAMPLE (the strongest form of the control), reaches 0.530 (CI 0.523-0.538) — the detector is not reading colour. JPEG: the feature is identical on every record, so the control is a structural 0.500, not a measured one.

IN-DATASET 0.928 (bench/gend_fit.json) MEASURES MEMORISATION and appears here only to be ruled out as the headline.
